title: Preparation of highly efficient chitosan-based flame retardant coatings with good antibacterial properties for cotton fabrics
treatment_chemistry: 10 g PVA and 30 g melamine phosphate
treatment_method: Wash cotton in deionized water and dry at 60 C for 1 h. Dissolve 10 g PVA in 100 mL water; prepare 10 g PVA and 30 g melamine phosphate coating at 70 C. Soak fabric at 70 C for 10 min, pad three times, dry at 100 C for 6 min and cure at 150 C for 2 min.
weight_gain_definition_status: Table 1 reported value only; Eq. 2 variable definitions reverse control/coated order, so normalized add-on is withheld.
LOI_method: ISO 4589-2; Rheometric Scientific oxygen index instrument; ambient conditions
TG_locator: Table 5, p 9; section 3.6, pp 8-9, confirms T10, Tmax and residue at 750 C.
LOI_locator: Table 2, p 5, initial fabric LOI; bracketed values are delta LOI, not uncertainty.
conditions_locator: Section 2.4, p 3: nitrogen, 30 mL/min, 10 C/min, room temperature to 750 C; ISO LOI method and specimen dimensions.
pairing_evidence: Tables 2 and 5 use the same initial coated cotton labels MP30, nCH30 and MCHP30. Table 1 and section 2.3 define their formulations. Separate Table 7 post-wash LOIs have no corresponding post-wash TG and are excluded.
limitations: Public readable original article text on Scribd inspected, not its AI summary; no PDF pixel review claimed. Untreated control held for possible cross-paper thermal-data reuse. Other initial and washed states lack matched TG. Reported weight gain retained separately due to reversed equation definitions. Bracketed delta LOI is not uncertainty. No burn-test residue or approximate stage boundary is used as TG residue/onset.
